name: nayanote
description: ADHD-friendly AI personal organization and RAG system (zero-cost-first, local-first)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nayanote/api" "npm run dev -w @nayanote/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nayanote/shared && npm run build -w @nayanote/api && npm run build -w @nayanote/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nayanote/shared && npm run test -w @nayanote/api && npm run test -w @nayanote/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nayanote/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nayanote/api && npm run typecheck -w @nayanote/web
